name: Hot Ones Versus
description: Welcome to Hot Ones Versus! On this brand new, Hot Ones spinoff series, guests have two choices: Tell the truth, or suffer the wrath of the Last Dab. Whoever eats the most wings, loses!

videos.title: Insane Clowns Posse vs. GWAR
videos.overview:
Everyone’s on the Naughty List when two of music’s wildest acts Insane Clown Posse and GWAR go head to head on the Hot Ones Versus Holiday Special!!! The bands have shocking and thrilling audiences for decades but today, they'll have two choices: Tell the truth, or suffer the wrath of the Last Dab. Whoever eats the most wings, loses!

From GWAR’s mythological beginning to ICP’s knowledge of Faygo, they will either need to be honest or go head-to-head with the Wings of Death. Does GWAR know Juggalo lingo? Who can decorate a Christmas tree with their trademark projectile? Tune in to an all-new episode of Hot Ones Versus, and see who takes home the coveted chicken wing trophy!

videos.overview:
Charlotte Flair and Alexa Bliss are two of WWE’s most decorated superstars - with multiple World Title wins and even a tag team title reign between. But today “Charlexa" has two choices: Tell the truth, or suffer the wrath of the Last Dab. Whoever eats the most wings, loses!

From naming their best match together, to rating their previous looks, these long time friends will either need to be honest, or go head-to-head with the Wings of Death. Will Charlotte rank her fellow Four Horsewomen? What happens when Alexa’s husband Ryan Cabrera crashes the party? Tune in to an all-new episode of Hot Ones Versus, and see who takes home the coveted chicken wing trophy!
